WITH race_entries AS (
  SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM constructorResults
  GROUP BY raceId
), average_entries AS (
  SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS avg_entry_count
  FROM race_entries
)
SELECT re.raceId, c.country, re.total_points, re.entry_count,
       re.entry_count - ae.avg_entry_count AS difference_from_average
FROM race_entries AS re
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = re.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
CROSS JOIN average_entries AS ae
WHERE re.entry_count > ae.avg_entry_count
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10
